<!-- What changes, for whoever uses the package, and why. One subject per pull request (CONTRIBUTING.md). -->

## The change



## Checked

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:gallery && npm run check:package`
- [ ] Its line in `CHANGELOG.md`, under `[Unreleased]`, in its section; **Upgrading** when something changes, is deprecated or removed
- [ ] Seen in the gallery in both themes, with an accent and with glass; by keyboard where it acts
- [ ] A new or changed export: named in its entry, the snapshot (`npx vitest run -u`), its family, guidelines and examples, `npm run props`
- [ ] Nothing renamed or removed at once: the old name kept, `@deprecated`, a line under Deprecated
- [ ] A copy of EasyUI changed: `// ioiti-ui:` on each change, a line in `docs/easyui-changes.md`
